component.name: LiteHub
component.summary: Lightweight all-in-one hub for WhatsApp, Slack, Discord, Gmail and more

description.p: One window for many web services, each instance with its own isolated login: several WhatsApps (linked-device QR login), Gmails, Outlooks, Telegram, Slack, Discord, Teams, Messenger and custom sites.

Chromium engine with calls, video and screen sharing, a shared download manager, per-app notifications, tray badge, dark/light themes and custom CSS/JS. Unofficial; not affiliated with any of these services.
